items.summary: Fix the RoleSelectionPage so that it does not pre-populate or lock in a previously chosen role. When an authenticated user reaches the role selection screen, they must be presented with a fresh, unselected choice between Customer and Freelancer, and the previously stored role must not influence or pre-select the UI state.

Fix the LoginPage redirect logic so that users who already have a role assigned in the backend are sent directly to their role-appropriate dashboard, bypassing the role selection page entirely. The role selection page should only be shown to users who have no role stored yet.
